title: Build and audit image–text retrieval
hardware: CPU synthetic image/text fixture; target runtime unverified

stages.title: Pair and preprocessing contracts
stages.evidence: Independent pixel/token checks, stable IDs, source groups and leakage rejection
stages.expected: PASS stage 1 plus all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: A shape-correct pair can still be semantically wrong; inspect the actual image and caption.

stages.title: Symmetric contrastive objective
stages.evidence: Independent host objective, normalization and finite differences at changed parameters
stages.expected: PASS stage 2 plus all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: Inspect the positive mask before adjusting temperature or optimizer settings.

stages.title: Training and complete recovery
stages.evidence: Two training seeds, frozen evaluation and five resumed transitions in a fresh process
stages.expected: PASS stage 3 plus all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: Compare pair IDs first, then weights, momentum and the future shuffle key.

stages.title: Precision and exported branches
stages.evidence: Calibration provenance, integer oracle and twelve serialized computations loaded in fresh processes
stages.expected: PASS stage 4 plus all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: Check preprocessing and scale axes before relaxing parity tolerance.

stages.title: Inference, measured release and rollback
stages.evidence: Boundary rejection, raw timings, degraded-candidate rejection and pointer preservation
stages.expected: PASS stage 5 plus all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: A good file checksum does not establish model quality; evaluate the candidate before selecting it.

rubric: Validate paired semantic inputs and split by source identity
Derive and independently check a multi-positive objective
Train both encoders and inspect clean versus shifted retrieval
Restore optimizer, random and iterator state in a fresh process
Verify calibrated integer arithmetic and serialized branch parity
Measure the actual request boundary and reject a degraded release
Bound conclusions to the synthetic CPU fixture
setupNote: Extract the ZIP and install its requirements-cpu.txt; run commands from the extracted top folder. Reference figures are measured on a synthetic CPU fixture.
